title: Lena Forsén — Wikipedia
summary: Wikipedia article on Lena Forsén, the Swedish model whose photo became the Lenna test image
description: Wikipedia's article on Lena Forsén (born Lena Söderberg), the Swedish model who appeared as a Playboy centerfold in November 1972. Her photograph was later cropped and scanned at USC, becoming the most famous test image in digital image processing history.
